# Bounded synthetic Modern sources

Ten original DOCX UI downloads, six retained actual App PDFs and one frozen,
SHA256-pinned manifest. All names, contact details and photo calibration blocks
are synthetic. No native candidate PDFs are copied here: CI regenerates them.

Provenance and precise limits: docs/qa/dossier-qa-integration.md.
The manifest stores source export SHAs, research report hashes, frozen App
measurements and verified candidate hashes. Do not edit it to silence a failed
gate. A future fixture refresh must retain explicit source/implementation
identity and independently verify its new expected result.
